result.title: Silicone hydrogel lens with crosslinked coating (amended)

limitations: L1: A coated silicone hydrogel contact lens, comprising: a silicone hydrogel contact lens and a non-silicone hydrogel coating thereon, wherein the non-silicone hydrogel coating is composed of a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material which comprises from about 20% to about 95% by weight of first polymer chains derived from a multi-arm polyethyleneglycol having terminal epoxide groups and from about 5% to about 80% by weight of a second polymer chains derived from at least one hydrophilicity-enhancing agent, wherein said at least one hydrophilicity-enhancing agent is selected from the group consisting of: PEG-NH2; PEG-SH; PEG-COOH; H2N-PEG-NH2; HOOC-PEG-COOH; HS-PEG-SH; H2N-PEG-COOH; HOOC-PEG-SH; H2N-PEG-SH: multi-arm PEG with at least one amino group; multi-arm PEG with at least one carboxyl group; multi-arm PEG with at least one thiol group; PEG dendrimers with at least one amino group; PEG dendrimers with at least one carboxyl group; PEG dendrimers with at least one thiol group; and combinations thereof, wherein the coated silicone hydrogel contact lens has at least one of the properties selected from the group consisting of: an oxygen permeability of at least about 40 barrers; an elastic modulus of about 1.5 MPa or less; an Ionoflux Diffusion Coefficient, D, of, at least about 1.5×10^−6 mm^2/min; a water content of from about 18% to about 70% by weight when fully hydrated; or combinations thereof.

L2: The coated silicone hydrogel contact lens of claim 1, wherein the crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material comprises from about 35% to about 90% by weight of the first polymer chains and from about 10% to about 65% by weight of the second polymer chains.

L3: The coated silicone hydrogel contact lens of claim 1, wherein the crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material comprises from about 50% to about 85% by weight of the first polymer chains and from about 15% to about 50% by weight of the second polymer chains.

L4: The coated silicone hydrogel contact lens of claim 1, wherein the second polymer chains are derived from at least one member selected from group consisting of: PEG-NH2; PEG-SH; PEG-COOH; and combinations thereof.

L5: The coated silicone hydrogel contact lens of claim 1, wherein the second polymer chains are derived from at least one member selected from group consisting of: H2N-PEG-NH2; HOOC-PEG-COOH; HS-PEG-SH; H2N-PEG-COOH; HOOC-PEG-SH; H2N-PEG-SH; and combinations thereof.
